summary: DockerImages (canary, df61622), KubeCoder (5bbf14b) and KitchenDisplay (067308b) run the aac-tools toolchain's arch-validate in their architecture Jenkinsfiles, local gates and instructions, and their copies are deleted. Each is pushed and done: its own builds are green (AaC consoles ran arch-validate in the aac-tools container), kubecoder-dev rolled Build-Main #558's pin Healthy, and the collector and site pins are green. Firmware/KitchenDisplay stayed disabled, so KitchenDisplay stayed in P11; close-out A4 (restart KitchenDisplay's environment for aac-tools) and N5 (KubeCoder pushed without its unreachable devlock) record the rest.
